d: On November 23, 2026, Saurav Das, co-convenor of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), was stopped by immigration officials at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport while attempting to board a flight to London. During a Delhi High Court hearing on November 26, the Centre revealed that a Look Out Circular (LOC) had been issued against him on the very day of his travel, alongside a show-cause notice from the Regional Passport Office (RPO) in Chennai alleging discrepancies in his passport application.
